## Problem

What builder, agent wallet, DAO treasury, or payment-bot workflow is currently
blocked or unnecessarily difficult?

## Proposed change

solve the problem.

## TrustPermit and Solana impact

decisions, and the existing Solana devnet boundary.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any workaround or adjacent approach you considered.

## Safety check
